cookieBanner.title: Cookies and privacy
cookieBanner.description: We use essential cookies for authentication and security. With your consent, we also use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to improve the experience. See our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By accessing or using Master Legends League ("MLL"), you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
Use of the platform is also subject to the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old or the age of majority in your jurisdiction to create an account and participate in play-and-earn features.
You are responsible for ensuring that use of MLL is permitted under the laws applicable to your country or region.

sections.title: 3. Account and conduct
paragraphs: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity on your account.
Bots, exploits, unauthorized automation, fraud, harassment, or any conduct that harms other players or game integrity is prohibited.

sections.title: 4. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All MLL content — including pixel art, UI, trademarks, code, and mechanics — belongs to its respective owners and is protected by law.
You receive a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license for personal use of the platform under these terms.

sections.title: 5. Suspension and termination
paragraphs: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, without prejudice to other legal remedies.
You may close your account at any time by contacting support.

sections.title: 6. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these Terms of Use: privacidade@mll.local

sections.title: 1. Service
paragraphs: MLL is a play-and-earn football ecosystem with digital elements, including NFTs, tokens, and marketplace, subject to availability and ongoing maintenance.
Features may be changed, limited, or discontinued with reasonable notice when possible.

sections.title: 2. Account and registration
paragraphs: Registration requires express acceptance of these terms and the Privacy Policy.
Information provided must be accurate. Duplicate or fraudulent accounts may be terminated.

sections.title: 3. Game economy and digital assets
paragraphs: Items, virtual currencies (e.g. USDC), NFTs, and rewards follow in-game rules and do not guarantee financial value.
On-chain transactions are subject to the rules of the blockchain network used; gas fees and confirmations are the user's responsibility.
MLL is not liable for losses from market volatility, network failures, or third-party wallets.

sections.title: 4. Payments and refunds
paragraphs: Purchases of digital items or passes, when available, are generally final unless otherwise required by law.
Refunds follow applicable Brazilian law and policies disclosed at the time of purchase.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The platform is provided "as is" within the limits permitted by law.
We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, absence of bugs, or specific outcomes in competitions or marketplace.

sections.title: 6. Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil.
Venue: consumer's domicile when the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code applies.

sections.title: 1. Controller and DPO
paragraphs: Controller: Master Legends League.
Data Protection Officer (DPO): privacidade@mll.local

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Registration data: email, username, password (stored hashed), referral code.
Usage data: access logs, IP, user-agent, in-game actions, and security audit.
Web3 wallet data (when enabled): public wallet address.
Analytics data (with consent): pages visited and navigation events via Google Analytics.

sections.title: 3. Legal bases (LGPD)
paragraphs: Contract performance: account creation, authentication, and service delivery.
Legitimate interest: security, fraud prevention, and product improvement.
Consent: analytics cookies and marketing communications, when applicable.
Legal obligation: records required by law.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: Essential cookies: session/refresh tokens (httpOnly), CSRF, and language preference — required for operation.
Analytics cookies: Google Analytics, loaded only after your consent in the cookie banner.
Cloudflare Turnstile: used on login and registration for anti-bot verification; may process technical data per Cloudflare's policy.

sections.title: 5. Sharing
paragraphs: We may share data with infrastructure providers (hosting, email, Redis, database) under processing agreements.
Google Analytics (Google LLC) receives anonymized navigation data when you accept analytics cookies.
We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: 6. Retention
paragraphs: Account data: while the account is active and as needed after closure for legal obligations.
Operational logs: per internal policy (e.g. 90 days in MongoDB for high-volume logs).
Verification and reset tokens: expire automatically per system configuration.

sections.title: 7. Your rights (data subject)
paragraphs: You may request: confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability, deletion, and consent withdrawal.
Send requests to privacidade@mll.local. We will respond within LGPD timeframes.
You may also file a complaint with the ANPD (Brazil).

sections.title: 8. Security
paragraphs: We use technical and organizational measures: HTTPS, JWT tokens, httpOnly cookies, rate limiting, audit, and password hashing.
No system is 100% secure; notify us immediately if you suspect compromise.

sections.title: 9. Changes
paragraphs: This policy may be updated. The last revision date is shown at the top of the page.
Material changes will be communicated by reasonable means (e.g. site notice or email).

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small files stored in your browser to remember preferences, maintain sessions, and measure site usage.
We use cookies and similar technologies as described in this policy and the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 2. Essential cookies
paragraphs: Required for login, refresh token (httpOnly), CSRF protection, language, and basic security.
They do not require consent because they are essential to platform operation.

sections.title: 3. Analytics cookies
paragraphs: Google Analytics is loaded only after you accept cookies in the consent banner.
These cookies help us understand visited pages and improve the experience without selling personal data.

sections.title: 4. Cloudflare Turnstile
paragraphs: We use Turnstile on login and registration to reduce bots. Cloudflare may process technical data under its policy.

sections.title: 5. How to manage
paragraphs: You can refuse analytics cookies in the banner or clear cookies in your browser settings.
Refusing essential cookies may prevent login and use of protected features.

sections.title: 1. Nature of digital assets
paragraphs: NFTs, tokens (e.g. USDC), and on-chain rewards can lose value quickly. There is no guarantee of financial return.
Participating in MLL is entertainment and game progression; it is not investment advice.

sections.title: 2. Blockchain risks
paragraphs: Transactions are irreversible after network confirmation. Gas fees, congestion, and forks are user risks.
Incorrect wallet addresses may result in permanent loss of assets.

sections.title: 3. Wallets and custody
paragraphs: You are responsible for private keys, seed phrases, and device security.
MLL does not recover assets lost to phishing, malware, or shared credentials.

sections.title: 4. Smart contracts
paragraphs: Smart contracts may contain bugs or be targeted by exploits despite audits and testing.
Web3 features may be experimental or unavailable on certain networks.

sections.title: 5. Regulation
paragraphs: Laws on crypto assets vary by country and may change. Verify that platform use is permitted in your jurisdiction.

sections.title: 1. Expected conduct
paragraphs: Treat other players with respect in chat, Discord, Telegram, and official channels.
Harassment, hate speech, spam, scams, and illegal content are prohibited.

sections.title: 2. User-generated content
paragraphs: You retain rights to what you publish, but grant MLL a limited license to display and moderate service-related content.
Do not publish third-party personal data without consent.

sections.title: 3. Moderation
paragraphs: We may remove content, mute, or ban accounts that violate these terms or harm the community.
Moderation decisions aim to protect players and game integrity.

sections.title: 4. Official channels
paragraphs: Official Discord and Telegram links will be published on the site when available.
Beware of profiles asking for passwords, seed phrases, or payments outside official channels.

sections.title: 5. Reports
paragraphs: Report abuse to privacidade@mll.local or moderators on official channels, with evidence when possible.
